# The `ise` command line

`./ise` is `node tools/ise.mjs` in the Iṣẹ́ Studio repository. Every command takes `--project <name>` (the project to act on) and `--url ws://127.0.0.1:7420/ws` (the engine).

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `run steps.json [--from N] [--fresh] [--project name] [--url ws://127.0.0.1:7420/ws]` | steps already applied (same step, same parameters) are skipped, so a rerun after a failure continues from it; --from N starts at step N; --fresh applies every step again |
| `check` |  |
| `gears <id> [torque N·m] [rpm]` | turn a gear train through a full turn; tooth strength with a load |
| `motion <joint id> [steps] [--set '{"Elbow":40}']` | sweep a joint through its limits: what moves, closest approaches, clashes, where it binds |
| `fit <assembly or instance id \| project> [--motion]` | do screws, inserts, nuts, bearings and joined parts fit (and, with --motion, every joint's sweep) |
| `check-geometry <id> [part]` | the exact kernel's check of each part: valid, self-intersections, tolerances |
| `surfaces <id> [part] [--pull x,y,z] [--min deg]` | surface analysis: continuity across every seam (gap, crease, curvature jump), tightest bend, draft |
| `bom <assembly id \| project> [qty]` | the bill of materials as CSV: what is made (and how), what is bought, totals |
| `rates [refresh [EUR GBP…]]` | the exchange and process rates in use, with when each exchange rate was set; refresh: today's ECB reference rates (fetched only then) for the currencies listed or already used |
| `set-study <shape id> study.json [--part X]` | save a part's stress/heat study (faces as { normal, near: [x, y, z] }) |
| `stress\|fatigue\|modes\|buckle\|heat\|converge\|inp <shape id> [--part X] [--count N] [--resolutions 32,48,64]` | run the part's saved study (inp: a CalculiX deck on stdout) |
| `probe <key> x,y,z · section <key> x,y,z nx,ny,nz · path <key> x,y,z x,y,z [n] · csv <key>` | read a stress result back (the key a stress run prints) |
| `frame frame.json` | a frame of beams (joints, members with sections, supports, loads) |
| `plate <shape id> plate.json [--part X]` | a flat sheet part as a plate (edges clamped or simply held, pressure) |
| `materials [search]` | the material library with sources, and the project's materials |
| `dof <assembly \| top>` | what can still move (and how), mobility, redundant and conflicting joints |
| `interference <assembly \| instance \| top> [clearance mm]` | parts that overlap (volume, where), touch, or come close |
| `exploded <view>` | a saved exploded view's steps and trails |
| `study <study> [fps] [--out frames.json]` | play a motion study: what moves, clashes, binding; frames to a file |
| `robot <tip> [fk '{"Shoulder":30}' \| ik x,y,z [--axis 0,0,-1] \| reach [samples] \| path '[{"pose":"home"},{"to":[x,y,z],"linear":true}]' \| controller [json\|arduino] [--out f]] [--tool connector]` |  |
| `stock [search]` | the stock library: families, or the sizes matching (M3×12, 608, servo) |
| `render [--width 1920] [--height 1080] [--samples 256] [--studio white\|studio] [--skin "Left side,Top"] [--headless] [--timeout minutes] [--out f.png]` | a photoreal PNG of the model from the open view (headless Chrome if none is open); white: a seamless white sweep for product shots; --skin lays the product's calibrated photos (canvases) onto the faces they saw (none: off); --headless renders in a browser of its own even when a view is open |
| `render --glb product.glb` | the shown model as a .glb for a website (the render's materials and printed labels; metres, Y up, on the ground) |
| `flat [id \| project] [part] [--dxf f.dxf] [--svg f.svg] [--csv f.csv]` | sheet-metal parts: flat size, bend table, checks; the laser DXF |
| `pcb parts\|add\|footprint\|verify-footprints\|gerber-check\|library …` | KiCad library parts, footprint and Gerber checks |
| `pcb calc\|panel\|gerbview\|glb …` | board calculators, panelization, the Gerber viewer, the board as glTF |
| `pcb route\|drag\|cleanup\|optimize …` | the interactive router: pad to pad (walkaround/shove), drag a track or via, tidy copper |
| `pcb import <file> [--format f] [--name n] [--board id] [companions…]` | a board/schematic from KiCad, Eagle, EasyEDA, Altium, CADSTAR, Fabmaster, PADS, gEDA |
| `pcb exports <id> \| export <id> <file name \| kicad_sch \| ipc2581 \| odb \| d356 \| …> [--out path]` | files for other EDA tools |
| `sch export <schematic> netlist\|bom\|svg\|pdf [--format kicad\|orcad\|cadstar\|spice] [--out f]` | schematic files; sch find\|erc\|buses\|sheets <schematic> |
| `pcb lib\|logo\|assign\|variant\|block …` | project/global libraries, wizards, logos, footprint assignment, variants, design blocks |
| `pcb drc\|setup\|stackup\|rules\|teardrops <board> …` | checks, stackup (2–32 layers), custom rules (.kicad_dru), teardrops |
| `pcb netclass\|pair\|group\|lengths\|tune\|route-pair\|pad-to-die <board> …` | impedance targets (widths per layer), diff pairs, length groups, meanders |
| `pcb text\|draw\|image\|keepout\|stitch\|fence <board> …` | board graphics, keepouts, via stitching and fences |
| `pcb align\|distribute\|move\|array\|flip\|swap <items…> [--board id] · pcb channel <board> --source … --to …` | placement, multichannel |
| `simulate <schematic> [--tran 30ms] [--expect "min(V(3V3), burst) > 3.0"] [--save name]` | ngspice on a schematic |
| `list` | every entity, one line each |
| `tree` | what is placed, as a tree (instances, parts) |
| `get <id>` | one entity in full (program source, params, results) |
| `commit <operation> '<json>'` | one command (same $file inlining) |
| `image add <file> … [--name label.png]` | store pictures (PNG, JPEG) or fonts (TTF, OTF) for programs; prints each id (--name: what one file is called in the project) |
| `image list` | the pictures and fonts in the project |
| `image profile <file\|id> --height mm` | a photo's object measured: its outline as a profile to revolve |
| `look [what] [--view iso\|front\|top\|…\|az,el] [--size 1000x750] [--box x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1] [--out file.png]` | a picture of the model (or one thing in it) drawn by the engine, saved to look/…png |
| `canvas add <photo\|picture id> [--plane front\|back\|left\|right\|top\|bottom] [--object WxH --align 'left bottom'` | \| --calibrate u1,v1,u2,v2,mm \| --width mm \| --scale mm/px] [--at x,y,z] [--anchor u,v] [--rotate deg \| --level u1,v1,u2,v2] [--flip] [--aspect k] [--crop l,t,r,b] [--perspective u1,v1,…,u4,v4,WxH] [--opacity 0.5] [--through] [--name N] \| list \| update <canvas> [same] [--reset crop,…] \| remove <canvas>   reference pictures placed and calibrated in the model |
| `canvas measure <canvas> [--every mm] [--channel brightness --threshold 0.35] [--region l,t,r,b] [--all]` | the outline in mm: bounds, spans at stations |
| `canvas match [<canvas>\|all] [--of <thing>] [--out f.png]  ·  look --overlay <canvas> [what]` | the model drawn square to the canvas over its photo: silhouette IoU, outline distance, regions of extra/missing material |
| `ops [filter]` | the commands the engine accepts, with schemas |
| `view <action> [what] show something in the person's view (not saved):` | select L26 · frame L26 · isolate L26 · show_all · hide L19 · show L19 color status\|material · camera iso\|front\|back\|left\|right\|top\|bottom · camera az,el[,lens°[,fill]] render [white\|studio]   (render mode; white: the seamless white sweep) explode Bracket [spread] · explode Bracket off projection ortho\|perspective · display shaded\|edges\|wireframe\|hidden\|xray section x 25 [flip] · section box x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1 · section off measure Bracket [Plate]   (part, or part to part, measured in their view) |
| `measure <part> [other part] [--part name]` | volume, area, mass, centre of mass, |
| `drawing <id> [--sheet A3] [--part Name] [--page N] [--pdf f] [--svg f] [--dxf f] [--zip f]` | the engineering drawing: sheets, dimensions, the checker's findings; saves files moments of inertia (kg·mm² about the centre of mass); with two: centre to centre and the gap per axis |
| `bim [id\|project]` | the building: levels and what stands on each, spaces, zones, grids |
| `schedule [id\|project] [--class wall,door] [--level name] [--by level,class] [--csv] [--psets] [--out f.csv]` |  |
| `ifc export [id\|project] [file.ifc]  ·  ifc import <file.ifc>` |  |
| `plan [id\|project] --level name [--cut 1200] \| --section x\|y <mm> [--looking east] \| --elevation south` | [--sheet A3] [--scale 100] [--pdf file.pdf] [--dxf file.dxf] |
| `sheet <sheet>` | a spreadsheet as a grid: what each cell shows, aliases, errors |
| `draft` | draft objects, dimensions with their values, layers, working planes, arrays |
| `import <file> [--name N] [--as sheet\|parameters\|configurations] [--target id] [--sheet name]` | STEP/IGES (exact, also .stpz, .brep) and STL/OBJ/PLY/glTF/GLB/3MF (mesh) become a shape, DXF/SVG a sketch, .scad a live parametric shape, .csv/.xlsx a sheet, parameter set or configurations, .ise a new project |
| `export <id\|name\|project> <file.ext> \| --format step\|iges\|stl\|obj\|ply\|glb\|3mf\|dxf\|stpz\|brep\|scad\|zip\|csv\|xlsx [--part P] [--out path]` |  |
| `bundle [file.ise]` | the whole project (history, assets) as one file |
| `insert --from <project> [ids or names…] [--all] [--copy] [--auto] [--at x,y,z \| --origin] [--list] [--dry-run]` | items of another project (parts, assemblies, sub-assemblies, boards… or --all), linked to follow it unless --copy |
| `links [update [id] \| break <id> \| auto <id> on\|off \| local <id> on\|off]` | this project's links: up to date or not; take, cut, automate; local: edit the linked items here (else they are read-only, as their source made them) |
| `files ls [path] \| rm <path…> [-r] \| mv <from> <to> [-f]` | files in your folder (the Iṣẹ́ AI's own), never outside it |
| `scan add <file> [--source colmap] \| list \| info \| fit <scan> [kind] [--near x,y,z --within r] \| detect` | \| downsample \| outliers \| normals \| reconstruct [--depth 7] \| surface [--poles 8] \| shape \| export \| remove point clouds (XYZ/PLY/PCD/E57) and meshes: add, thin, fit primitives, rebuild surfaces |
| `mesh check\|repair\|decimate\|smooth\|remesh\|fill-holes\|split\|merge\|section\|curvature\|segment\|unwrap <scan> …` | \| mesh from <part> [--tolerance] [--angle] [--max-edge]   mesh evaluation and repair, reworking, sections, flattening |
| `inspect <scan> <part> --tolerance mm [--align icp\|best] [--required 0.99] [--require]` | deviation of a scan from its CAD part: statistics, pass/fail, as a requirement |
| `scan photos <folder \| photos.zip \| photo …> [--engine auto\|object-capture\|colmap] [--detail preview\|reduced\|medium\|full] [--mask] [--name N] [--detach]` | photogrammetry: photos → a sized, levelled scan and a cleaned one, with quality (photos used, reprojection, scale, coverage) |
| `scan engines \| jobs \| cancel <job> \| markers [--letter] [--out f.pdf] \| quality <scan>` |  |
| `scan scale <scan> --from x,y,z --to x,y,z --distance mm [--pick mm] \| --factor f  ·  scan level <scan>` |  |
| `scan render-photos <folder> [--count 40] [--rings 25,50] [--distance mm] [--fov 45] [--sheet]` | a test photo set of the model |
